itens.trecho: Uma fórmula que já cansou o público Este filme passa-se na deriva continental e é outra sequela de "Ice Age". Neste filme, os animais enfrentarão os perigos de um planeta em mudança e tentarão manter-se juntos antes de se separarem e deriva dos continentes.

By now, we are all maybe all a bit too familiar with "Scrat" chasing his acorn and with his expanding group of friends' adventures in the frozen north. I certainly found this story to be entertaining enough, but running short on ideas and somewhat repetitive.
GRANNY IS ICONIC OMG I watched this for the first time as a five year old at my great-grandpa's funeral and peter dinklage monkey haunted my dreams for years after (3.5/5, originally reviewed 8/4/24)
